scope.en: Auricle/pinna exterior only;36 source regions,1µm seam weld and2-level interpolation. Medial cut/open boundaries remain; no canal, tympanum, middle/inner ear or watertightness claim.
scope.zh: 仅耳廓外观；36个来源分区，1µm接缝合并与2级插值。保留内侧切割/开放边界；无耳道、鼓膜或中内耳，不声称水密。

gatePolicy: Verbatim existing gallery gates; no new validation or gate/count change.

historicalReview.status: Existing scoped static visual acceptance; retained, not re-reviewed in this migration
limitations: Auricle/pinna exterior only, not whole-ear volume. Exposed medial attachment/cut boundary remains.
No auditory canal, tympanic membrane, middle or inner ear. No licensed inner-ear geometry included.
36 named source regions (18per side), joined with1micrometre seam tolerance then2-level Catmull-Clark interpolation. No anatomy added or canal capped.
One-way final-vertex-to-source-surface distance max0.58013mm,mean0.03173mm,not bidirectional Hausdorff.
Open/nonmanifold source region boundaries remain; no watertight, clinical or browser-runtime pass.
Z-Anatomy native source frame, not BP3D4 or CT registration.

sourceFrame: Z-Anatomy native evaluated world only; separate from BP3D/CT. No recentering, alignment or default whole-body assembly.
warnings: Auricle/pinna exterior only, 18 source regions per side; medial attachment/cut and open/non-manifold boundaries remain.
No canal, tympanic membrane, middle/inner ear, whole-ear volume or watertightness claim.
One-way sampled final-vertex-to-source discrepancy is not bidirectional Hausdorff or anatomical validation.
changes: Historical r04 compounds 36 source regions, applies a 1 micrometre seam tolerance and two Catmull-Clark interpolation levels; does not add/cap a canal. This migration makes no geometry/material/transform edits.

failureLesson.en: Interpolation can improve seams, not recover missing inner-ear anatomy or close a medial source boundary.
failureLesson.zh: 插值可改善接缝，但不能恢复缺失的中内耳解剖或证明内侧边界闭合。
